entries.name: zhanggui
entries.description: Use when a development request is ambiguous, cross-module, multi-deliverable, checkpointed, or explicitly asks for end-to-end work from discovery or design through implementation and verified delivery. Also use when invoked explicitly. Do not use for isolated debugging, TDD, verification, review, review-feedback, worktree, parallel-agent, or branch-finishing requests handled by zhanggui-* skills. When selected implicitly, begin with "已自动进入 Zhanggui 完整工作流：" plus the observed high-signal reason before any non-skill tool call.

entries.name: zhanggui-systematic-debugging
entries.description: Use when an isolated bug, test failure, build failure, performance problem, or unexpected behavior needs root-cause investigation; defer to the zhanggui root when the user explicitly invokes it or requests an ambiguous or end-to-end workflow

entries.name: zhanggui-test-driven-development
entries.description: Use when an isolated production feature, bug fix, refactor, or behavior change needs Red-Green-Refactor before implementation; defer to the zhanggui root for explicit, ambiguous, cross-module, or end-to-end workflows

entries.name: zhanggui-verification-before-completion
entries.description: Use when an isolated claim of complete, fixed, passing, or ready needs fresh evidence before commit, push, PR, or task transition; do not use when the user explicitly skips verification, or when they state tests passed or verification completed and primarily request branch integration, because the finishing leaf owns its verification prerequisite; defer to the zhanggui root for explicit or end-to-end workflow ownership

entries.name: zhanggui-requesting-code-review
entries.description: Use when asking for a new independent review of a diff or code change, including severity-scoped reports such as Critical and Important findings, before verification, merge, delivery, or dependent work; defer to the zhanggui root for explicit, cross-module, or end-to-end workflow ownership

entries.name: zhanggui-receiving-code-review
entries.description: Use when existing review feedback or comments need technical verification before acceptance, rejection, or implementation; do not use for a new review request of a diff or code change; defer to the zhanggui root when feedback belongs to an explicit or end-to-end workflow it already owns

entries.name: zhanggui-using-git-worktrees
entries.description: Use when isolated feature work needs a protected checkout, separate write scope, or implementation-plan workspace; defer to the zhanggui root when worktree setup is one step in an explicit or end-to-end workflow

entries.name: zhanggui-dispatching-parallel-agents
entries.description: Use when two or more independent problem domains can run concurrently without shared state or overlapping writes, including separate root-cause investigations across different components; do not use when subagent capacity is unavailable or the user asks to pretend parallel work is finished; defer to the zhanggui root when parallel work belongs to an explicit, cross-module, or end-to-end workflow

entries.name: zhanggui-finishing-a-development-branch
entries.description: Use when the user states tests passed or verification is complete, or verified branch or worktree work now needs the explicit choice to merge, push a PR, keep, or discard; do not use when the user explicitly says verification is missing; defer to the zhanggui root when finishing is the last step of an explicit or end-to-end workflow it owns
